admin-overview.title: Admin — Overview tab
admin-overview.what: The landing tab: headline counters, the 30-day chart, live transfers and the recent-events mini list.

admin-live.title: Admin — Live tab
admin-live.what: Upload sessions happening right now, over a hibernatable WebSocket, plus finished-this-hour.

admin-drops.title: Admin — Drop links tab and link detail
admin-drops.what: Creating, configuring and inspecting drop links: settings, budgets, theme, uploads, upload-session log.

admin-shares.title: Admin — Share links tab
admin-shares.what: Creating and managing share links, index state, previews and orphan sweeps from the share card.

admin-activity-people.title: Admin — Activity and People tabs
admin-activity-people.what: The event timeline with filters and export, and one profile per visitor with device/account stitching.

admin-pipelines.title: Admin — Pipelines tab
admin-pipelines.what: One view of every background job: share indexing, RAW/HEIC previews, WebP thumbnails, video previews, image archive, the Drive change feed, R2 sweeps, and the GitHub runs behind them.

admin-media-jobs.title: Admin — Video previews and Image archive tabs
admin-media-jobs.what: The two long-running media pipelines with their own tabs: transcoder telemetry and coverage, and the re-encode planner with rules and undo.

admin-logs.title: Admin — System log tab
admin-logs.what: The app log from the Durable Object's SQLite, with filters and read-state.

share-gallery.title: Share page — gallery, folders, selection
share-gallery.what: What a guest sees: folder tiles with stats and hover previews, the justified photo grid, sorting and filtering, selection, and the download bar.

share-viewer.title: Share page — the lightbox viewer
share-viewer.what: Opening a photo or video: navigation, filmstrip, zoom, file info and EXIF, motion settings, video controls, mobile action sheet.

share-delivery.title: Share page — media delivery and downloads
share-delivery.what: How bytes reach the guest: the cache ladder, signed media URLs, Range downloads, WebP choice, ZIP of a selection.

share-index.title: Share indexing and change detection
share-index.what: The chunked Drive walk that produces folder stats and file rows, the change feed, scheduling, resume, dedupe and orphan sweeps.

drop-upload.title: Drop page — the upload experience
drop-upload.what: What a sender sees: the gate, picking files, preflight dedupe, the queue with per-file state, retries, the stall watchdog, the summary.

platform.title: Platform — router, auth, storage, Drive
platform.what: The pieces everything else sits on: the router, admin and viewer auth, KV state, Drive access, email, shared helpers.
